quotes.page: CFPB, What fees or charges are paid when closing on a mortgage and who pays them?
quote: When you are buying a home you generally pay all of the costs associated with that transaction. However, depending on the contract or state law, the seller may end up paying for some of these costs.

Sometimes, you can negotiate with the seller for a “credit” towards your closing costs, but the seller will usually require you to pay a higher price for the home in order to cover the costs of this credit.

Common closing fees or charges may include: Appraisal fees; Tax service provider fees; Title insurance; Government taxes; Prepaid expenses such as property taxes, homeowners insurance, and interest until your first payment is due
